entries.wording: The shipment has been prepared for transportation by the sender.
entries.note: The sender has prepared the parcel and its data, at the sender's town.

entries.wording: The shipment has been handed over to a carrier and is now on it's way to PARCEL.ONE.
entries.note: A carrier has collected the parcel from the sender to bring it to PARCEL.ONE's hub.

entries.wording: The shipment arrived the P1 HUB and is now being handled.
The shipping label with trackingno <number> has been created.
entries.note: The delivery carrier's label, created at the hub after the parcel arrived there: no registration of the parcel. The number is the delivery carrier's.

entries.wording: The shipment has left the P1 HUB and can be tracked further in the tracking system of the respective carrier using the shipment number <number>.
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivery carrier. The reply links the number to that carrier's tracker; the adapter keeps the text.
A delivery carrier's scan as PARCEL.ONE relays it: Liechtenstein Post's processing in Schaan.

entries.wording: The shipment arrived at the distribution office.
entries.note: A delivery carrier's scan as PARCEL.ONE relays it.

entries.wording: The shipment is out for delivery and is expected to be delivered today.
entries.note: A delivery carrier's scan as PARCEL.ONE relays it.

entries.wording: The shipment has been delivered to the mailbox of the recipient.
entries.note: A delivery carrier's scan as PARCEL.ONE relays it.
A progress code, the parcel's and not a scan's. The tracking page's script reads it as its second step and labels it so; the adapter reads it only for a parcel without scans.
A progress code: the page's third step, the parcel at its destination.
A progress code: the page's fourth step.
A progress code: the page's last step, beside a delivery scan.
